newsitem.title: USA: California offers $50,000 reward for Cosby killer.
newsitem.headline: California offers $50,000 reward for Cosby killer.

text.p: The state of California on Friday offered a $50,000 reward for information leading to the arrest and conviction of the murderer of Ennis Cosby, U.S. entertainer Bill Cosby's son.

California's acting Gov. Gray Davis signed a proclamation offering the reward for information on the person, or persons, who gunned down the 27-year-old Cosby while he was changing a tire on a Los Angeles freeway last week.
Los Angeles police have circulated a composite sketch of a suspect, a white man. But they have so far made no arrests.

The proclamation signed by Davis said he was offering the reward after consultation with the Los Angeles Police Department about "the circumstances of the case and the current status of the investigation."
The reward would be paid out of the state's general fund. Davis, California's Democratic Lieutenant-Governor, is filling in for Republican Gov. Pete Wilson, who is in Asia on a trade trip.
